title: Fairness risk measures
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on fairness with respect to generic sensitive features, using race and gender as primary examples.
findings: The paper proposes a mathematical framework for fairness in machine learning classifiers with respect to sensitive features. However, it does not mention, analyze, or measure any aspect of religion or faith. The primary examples used for sensitive features are race and gender.
